results.snippet: Bloomberg L.P. is a privately held financial data, software, and media powerhouse headquartered at 731 Lexington Avenue in Midtown Manhattan. Founded on October 1, 1981, by Michael Bloomberg, Thomas Secunda, Duncan MacMillan, and Charles Zegar, with a 12% equity stake from Merrill Lynch, the company started as a single-product venture.
